[[File:Smoke Barrage icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Smoke Barrage''' is the highest tier [[smoke spell]] from the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook, available at level 86 [[Magic]]. It is capable of hitting up to 27 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Smoke Barrage is capable of [[poison]]ing a target at a 1/8 chance on hit, having a [[poison severity]] of 20 (where poison starts at 4 damage every 30 [[tick]]s or 18 seconds) with a maximum damage total of 50; this can be increased to 22 with an [[ancient sceptre]], increasing the total poison damage to 60 (first two hits does 5 damage). It is also able to target up to nine targets in a 3x3 grid around its primary target, just like all other [[Burst spells|burst]] and [[barrage spells]].

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.
